items.desc: Main color: Brown / cream / white. Outfit: Oversized brown hoodie with a large graphic print and drawstrings, sliding off one shoulder, worn over a white tiered ruffle mini skirt that peeks out from under the hem. Silhouette: Loose, boxy hoodie dress-style top over a short layered skirt. Length: Hoodie reaches mid-thigh, skirt just visible below. Sleeves: Long, extra-long sleeves that cover the hands, one hand held against the mouth. Footwear: Brown chunky lace-up sneakers, worn with white ribbed leg warmers. Accessories: Brown baseball cap with an embroidered butterfly, brown leather satchel with buckle straps worn crossbody. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair worn down under the cap, with soft face-framing strands.

Main color: White / pink / pale blue / cream. Outfit: Strapless white lace-trimmed bustier corset top with a lace-up front and ribbon bow, worn under an open pink plaid shirt that slides off the shoulders, with light blue distressed denim shorts. Silhouette: Fitted corset top with a defined waist, loose oversized shirt, short high-cut shorts. Length: Mini shorts, bare thighs. Sleeves: Long plaid shirt sleeves hanging off the shoulders, strapless top underneath. Footwear: Cream chunky lace-up platform boots, worn with cream cable-knit leg warmers. Accessories: Cream shoulder bag with a thin strap. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair with curled ringlets framing the face, center part.

Main color: Grey / white / black. Outfit: Oversized grey zip-up track jacket with white side stripes sliding off the shoulders, worn over a white spaghetti-strap crop top and grey baggy wide-leg track pants with white side stripes and a drawstring waist. Silhouette: Loose, relaxed streetwear with a cropped fitted top. Length: Full-length wide pants covering most of the shoes, cropped top showing the midriff. Sleeves: Long jacket sleeves hanging off the arms, hands in the pockets. Footwear: Grey and white chunky sneakers. Accessories: White over-ear headphones worn around the neck, black backpack hanging from one shoulder. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part.

Main color: Pink / white / cream. Outfit: Oversized pink knit cardigan hanging off the arms, over a white camisole with a small bow at the neckline and a white tiered ruffle mini skirt with a ribbon bow at the waist. Silhouette: Soft, feminine, slightly fitted top with a short layered skirt. Length: Mini skirt, bare thighs. Sleeves: Long loose cardigan sleeves slipping off the shoulders, hand touching the cheek. Footwear: Pink and white chunky platform sneakers with bows, worn with cream cable-knit leg warmers. Accessories: Small pink satchel with buckle straps held in the hand. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, soft strands falling over the shoulders.

Main color: Cream / light grey / white. Outfit: Oversized cream cable-knit sweater worn off one shoulder, with baggy light grey wide-leg sweatpants and a white drawstring waist. Silhouette: Loose, cozy and relaxed with an exposed shoulder. Length: Sweater reaches the hips, full-length pants pooling at the feet. Sleeves: Very long sweater sleeves covering the hands, arms folded in front of the chest. Footwear: White chunky sneakers. Accessories: White canvas tote bag with a teddy bear charm with a green bow. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, swept to one side, center part.

Main color: Pale pink / white / cream. Outfit: Sheer pink floral babydoll dress with a plunging front-tie bodice, lace-trimmed hem, layered high-low skirt, and ribbon-tie shoulder straps. Silhouette: Empire waist with a flowing, airy skirt. Length: Short in front, longer and layered at the back and sides. Sleeves: None, ribbon straps tied in bows on the shoulders. Footwear: White platform sandals with long ribbon ankle ties. Accessories: Ribbon bow at the neck. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, soft strands framing the face.

Main color: White / pale blue / light grey. Outfit: White ribbed crop camisole with a bow at the neckline, light blue distressed denim shorts with side lace-up detail, and an oversized white open shirt sliding off the shoulders. Silhouette: Cropped fitted top with a loose off-shoulder layer and short shorts. Length: Mini shorts, bare legs, midriff visible. Sleeves: Long loose shirt sleeves hanging off the arms, one hand in a pocket. Footwear: White chunky platform slides with bows. Accessories: White leather satchel with buckle straps worn crossbody. Hairstyle: High ponytail tied with a white fluffy scrunchie, with long wavy strands falling loose at the sides.

Main color: White / cream / straw beige. Outfit: White sundress with a square neckline, lace-up corset bodice with a ribbon bow, bow-tied shoulder straps, and a tiered ruffle mini skirt. Silhouette: Fitted bodice with a defined waist and a layered flared skirt. Length: Mini skirt, bare legs. Sleeves: None, ribbon bow straps on the shoulders. Footwear: White platform sandals with bows and ribbon ankle ties. Accessories: Wide-brim straw hat with a white ribbon, woven basket bag filled with white flowers. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, soft strands falling over the shoulders.

Main color: White / ivory. Dress: Sleeveless sundress with a square neckline, thin straps, and a fitted, seamed bodice with a defined waist, over a full flowing skirt. Silhouette: Hourglass shape with a flared, airy skirt. Length: Knee-length. Sleeves: None, bare shoulders and arms. Footwear: Tan platform espadrille sandals with ankle buckle straps. Accessories: Wide-brim straw hat with a long white ribbon trailing in the wind. Hairstyle: Extremely long loose pink hair in heavy curls and waves, with soft face-framing strands and curled ends pooling at the sides.

Main color: Dark brown / burgundy / black. Outfit: Oversized dark brown coat with chest pockets and buttoned cuffs, worn over a dark turtleneck and a burgundy plaid fringe scarf, with a dark mini skirt with buckle straps and metal rings, and patterned dark brown tights. Silhouette: Layered, loose coat over a short fitted skirt. Length: Coat to mid-thigh, mini skirt, tights to the boots. Sleeves: Long, loose coat sleeves, one hand holding the scarf at the collar. Footwear: Brown knee-high leather boots with several buckle straps and chunky platform soles. Accessories: Large brown leather satchel with buckles, burgundy fringe scarf. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair with curled strands at the front.

Main color: Brown / cream / white. Outfit: Cropped brown jacket with balloon sleeves and buckle straps on the sleeves, over a cream cable-knit turtleneck sweater and a brown and cream plaid pleated mini skirt, with sheer brown tights. Silhouette: Rounded oversized sleeves with a fitted waist and pleated skirt. Length: Mini skirt, tights to the shoes. Sleeves: Very puffy balloon sleeves with leather straps, falling past the hands. Footwear: Dark brown chunky platform loafers with tassels, worn with cream knit leg warmers. Accessories: White beret, brown leather satchel with buckles on a chain strap worn crossbody. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair worn under the beret, with soft face-framing strands.

Main color: Dark brown / burgundy / black. Outfit: Oversized dark brown coat with chest pockets and buttoned cuffs, worn over a dark turtleneck and a burgundy plaid fringe scarf, with a dark mini skirt with buckle straps and metal rings, and patterned dark brown tights. Silhouette: Layered, loose coat over a short fitted skirt. Length: Coat to mid-thigh, mini skirt, tights to the boots. Sleeves: Long, loose coat sleeves, one hand holding the scarf at the collar. Footwear: Brown knee-high leather boots with several buckle straps and chunky platform soles. Accessories: Large brown leather satchel with buckles, burgundy fringe scarf. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair with curled strands at the front.

Main color: Black / dark grey / brown. Outfit: Black puffer jacket with a grey faux-fur-trimmed hood worn down, over a dark ribbed turtleneck sweater, with black cuffed belted shorts and sheer black tights. Silhouette: Puffy, boxy jacket over a fitted base with short shorts. Length: Jacket to the hips, shorts, tights to the boots. Sleeves: Long puffy sleeves, one hand in the pocket, the other holding the scarf. Footwear: Tall glossy black-brown leather boots with several buckle straps and chunky platform soles. Accessories: Grey plaid fringe scarf, black leather shoulder bag. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, swept to one side, with curled strands at the front.

Main color: Ivory / cream / pale pink. Outfit: Fluffy cream sherpa jacket with puffy sleeves, worn over a cream cable-knit sweater mini dress and a pink plaid fringe scarf. Silhouette: Soft, rounded and cozy with a short fitted knit dress. Length: Mini dress, bare thighs. Sleeves: Very puffy fluffy sleeves, one hand raised near the scarf. Footwear: Cream platform lace-up boots with pom-poms, worn with cream knit leg warmers with pom-pom ties. Accessories: White fluffy beret with a small bow, pink shoulder bag with pom-pom and small character keychain charms. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair worn under the beret, with soft face-framing strands.

Main color: Ivory / cream / off-white. Outfit: Fluffy sherpa-style oversized jacket with puffed sleeves over a cream cable-knit sweater mini dress, worn with dark opaque tights. Silhouette: Soft, rounded and cozy, with voluminous sleeves and a fitted knit dress underneath. Length: Mini knit dress, tights to the boots. Sleeves: Long, puffed fluffy sleeves ending in white fuzzy mittens. Footwear: Brown leather buckle boots with chunky platform heels and white fur trim at the cuffs. Accessories: Chunky knit fringed scarf, white beret, white fluffy mittens. Hairstyle: Extremely long loose wavy hair worn down under the beret, falling in long soft waves.

Main color: Camel / beige / warm brown. Outfit: Oversized camel double-breasted coat with wide lapels and cuffed sleeves, worn open over a cream ribbed turtleneck and a brown plaid pleated mini skirt, with dark opaque tights. Silhouette: Boxy, layered outerwear over a fitted base, with a pleated skirt. Length: Coat to mid-thigh, mini skirt underneath. Sleeves: Long, loose coat sleeves with turned-back cuffs. Footwear: Brown leather ankle boots with a chunky block heel and a slouchy shaft. Accessories: Small brown leather top-handle bag with a thin chain strap worn across the body. Hairstyle: Extremely long loose wavy hair, parted near the center and falling in soft voluminous waves.

Main color: Cream / ivory / pale blue / white. Outfit: Short fluffy cream faux-fur bolero jacket worn open over a fitted cream ribbed turtleneck sweater, paired with light blue baggy wide-leg jeans with a low-rise waistband, a white waistband and a front button. Figure: Full, rounded bust that the fitted ribbed knit clearly shows; narrow, defined waist visible between the sweater hem and the jeans; soft hourglass shape; slim shoulders and thin arms under the fur sleeves; hips and legs are hidden by the loose jeans. Silhouette: Fitted, snug top against loose, voluminous bottom, with an oversized fluffy bolero adding volume on the arms. Length: Bolero ends at the ribcage, sweater ends at the waist, jeans full-length, hems pooling over the shoes. Sleeves: Long, wide, very fluffy fur sleeves, cuffs reaching the knuckles. Footwear: White chunky platform sneakers. Accessories: White ribbed knit beanie, cream leather shoulder bag with a thin belt strap, small white bunny plush charm hanging from the strap. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair falling past the knees, soft curls at the ends, center part, worn under the beanie.

Main color: Dark brown / black / charcoal grey. Outfit: Knee-length dark brown fitted coat with a wide belt cinched at the waist, large front toggle clasps, patch pockets and grey faux-fur cuffs, worn over a long layered sheer skirt with black lace trim along each tier, and a chunky grey knit scarf with fringe ends worn up to the chin. Figure: Full, high bust, clearly rounded under the buttoned coat; the belt marks a very narrow waist, which gives a strong hourglass shape; slim arms; the long skirt hides the legs completely. Silhouette: Fitted waist coat flaring slightly at the hips over a voluminous, tiered maxi skirt that widens toward the hem. Length: Coat to the knees, tiered lace skirt reaching the ankles. Sleeves: Long fitted sleeves with fluffy grey fur cuffs, black gloves. Footwear: Black chunky platform lace-up combat boots with buckle details. Accessories: Black fur ushanka hat with a silver and blue gem brooch, black leather satchel with two buckle straps worn crossbody, black gloves, chunky grey fringe scarf. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, falling past the knees, center part, worn down under the hat.

Main color: White / cream / dusty rose / pale grey. Outfit: Short oversized white puffer jacket with a high collar, ribbon bows and adjustable straps at the sides, unzipped over a fitted cream ribbed knit sweater, with white baggy wide-leg cargo pants with large flap pockets on the thighs and a thick dusty rose knit scarf with tassels worn over the chin. Figure: Full, round bust that stands out under the fitted ribbed sweater; the puffer jacket hides the waist and hips; thin arms in the puffy sleeves; legs hidden by the loose cargo pants; a soft, petite hourglass in the visible area. Silhouette: Boxy, rounded oversized jacket over a fitted base, loose straight wide pants. Length: Puffer ends at the hips, sweater at the waist, cargo pants full-length, hems covering the tops of the shoes. Sleeves: Long, very puffy quilted sleeves with ribbed cuffs, hands near the collar. Footwear: White chunky lace-up sneakers. Accessories: White faux-fur-trimmed hood worn up over the head, dusty rose knit tassel scarf, white backpack with ribbon bows on the straps. Hairstyle: Long wavy hair, mostly hidden under the hood, with soft curled strands framing the face and the rest falling over the shoulders and back.

Main color: Cream / ivory / pink / brown. Outfit: Cream cable-knit sleeveless mini sweater dress with a scoop neckline and a tiered ruffled hem, worn under an open oversized cream puffer jacket, with a pink plaid fringe scarf worn around the neck. Figure: Very full, rounded bust that the fitted cable-knit shows clearly; narrow waist; wide hips and soft, thick thighs fully visible between the dress hem and the leg warmers; slim shoulders and thin arms; a soft, curvy hourglass shape. Silhouette: Fitted, snug knit dress with a ruffled flared hem, wide puffy jacket opening around it. Length: Mini dress ending at the upper thigh, bare thighs, knee-high leg warmers. Sleeves: Very puffy quilted jacket sleeves, wide and rounded with gathered cuffs, hands hidden. Footwear: Cream platform shoes with a rounded toe, worn with cream ribbed knit leg warmers fastened with two tan buckle straps at the calf. Accessories: Pink plaid fringe scarf, brown leather satchel with a buckle strap and a teddy bear charm. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair falling past the knees, center part, soft curled strands in front of the shoulders.

Main color: Cream / ivory / soft beige / pale pink / muted green. Outfit: Cream fitted camisole-style bodice with thin spaghetti straps, a deep sweetheart neckline, delicate lace edging and tiny embroidered daisy flowers, with a large cream ribbon bow tied at the center of the bust. The bodice transitions into a high-waisted cream skirt with several wide gathered tiers and abundant ruffled hems, decorated with scattered tiny white and yellow flowers. An oversized soft cream cardigan is worn loosely off the shoulders, with voluminous sleeves and gathered cuffs. Figure: Very full, rounded bust emphasized by the fitted floral camisole; narrow waist; wide hips and soft rounded thighs; slim shoulders and delicate arms; soft feminine hourglass shape. Silhouette: Fitted floral camisole and defined waist transitioning into a voluminous layered ruffle skirt, softened by the oversized cardigan. Length: Short-to-mid-thigh skirt with multiple layered ruffles. Sleeves: Oversized long cardigan sleeves, loose and voluminous with gathered cuffs. Footwear: Cream platform sandals with rounded soles and large daisy-shaped floral decorations on the straps. Accessories: Large woven straw basket bag decorated with a cream ribbon bow and filled with a bouquet of white and pale-pink flowers; tiny floral hair accents. Hairstyle: Extremely long loose wavy pink hair falling far below the waist, center part, soft voluminous waves and curled strands framing the face and flowing around the body.

Main color: Cream / ivory / warm beige / brown / soft pink. Outfit: Fitted white-ivory corset-style camisole with thin shoulder straps, a sweetheart neckline, delicate lace trim and a structured lace-up front with long cream ribbons. High-waisted warm brown tailored shorts with belt loops, a wide brown leather belt and subtle vertical seam detailing. An oversized long beige trench coat is worn open over the outfit, with very loose sleeves and a relaxed draped silhouette. A large pink-and-cream plaid scarf is wrapped loosely around the neck. Figure: Very full, rounded bust clearly defined by the fitted corset top; narrow waist; wide hips and soft rounded thighs; slim shoulders and delicate arms; soft curvy hourglass shape. Silhouette: Fitted corset top and high-waisted shorts contrasted with a long oversized open trench coat, creating a relaxed layered silhouette. Length: High-waisted shorts ending at the upper thigh; long trench coat falling to the lower calf. Sleeves: Long oversized trench-coat sleeves, wide and softly gathered around the wrists. Footwear: Brown leather platform Mary Jane shoes with rounded toes and chunky soles, worn with tall cream ribbed knit leg warmers scrunched around the calves. Accessories: Large brown leather shoulder satchel with multiple buckles and straps, pink plaid scarf, cream beret with a soft rounded shape. Hairstyle: Very long loose wavy pink hair falling well past the waist, soft center part, voluminous curled strands framing the face and flowing behind the coat.

Main color: White / ivory / pastel pink / soft lavender / pale blue. Outfit: Fitted ivory floral camisole with thin spaghetti straps, a sweetheart neckline, delicate lace edging and tiny pastel floral embroidery. A large satin ribbon bow is tied at the center of the bust. The top flows into a very short high-waisted skirt composed of several extremely full gathered ruffle tiers, alternating ivory and very pale lavender layers with delicate lace edging and scattered tiny floral motifs. A cropped oversized pastel-pink cardigan is worn loosely over the shoulders, with long balloon sleeves and soft ribbed cuffs. Figure: Very full rounded bust emphasized by the fitted floral camisole; narrow waist; rounded hips and soft thighs; slim shoulders and delicate arms; soft feminine hourglass shape. Silhouette: Fitted bodice with a dramatically flared, multi-layered ruffle skirt and a cropped oversized cardigan, creating a cute doll-like silhouette. Length: Very short mini skirt ending high on the upper thigh, with the layered ruffles creating additional volume. Sleeves: Long oversized pink cardigan sleeves, loose and puffy with ribbed cuffs. Footwear: White platform shoes with chunky soles and large decorative bows, paired with tall white ribbed leg warmers with small ribbon details. Accessories: Small cream shoulder bag decorated with a cute white bunny plush/charm, delicate hair clip, small pastel accents. Hairstyle: Extremely long loose wavy pastel-pink hair reaching far below the waist, voluminous soft curls, side-swept front strands and flowing curled locks around the body.

Main color: Pastel pink / cream / white / soft brown. Outfit: Fitted ivory corset-style camisole with thin straps, a sweetheart neckline, vertical boning, delicate lace edging and a long ribbon bow at the center. A high-waisted pastel-pink pleated mini skirt sits closely at the waist and flares into soft accordion pleats, with a subtle layered hem. A fluffy oversized pastel-pink cropped jacket is worn loosely over the shoulders, featuring very large rounded sleeves, plush cuffs and a soft fuzzy texture. A long pink-and-cream plaid scarf hangs around the neck. Figure: Very full rounded bust emphasized by the structured fitted corset; narrow waist; rounded hips and soft thick thighs; slim shoulders and delicate arms; soft curvy hourglass figure. Silhouette: Fitted corset and high-waisted pleated mini skirt contrasted with a cropped oversized fluffy jacket, creating a soft voluminous upper layer while keeping the waist defined. Length: Mini skirt ending at the upper thigh, with bare thighs between the skirt and leg warmers. Sleeves: Oversized plush jacket sleeves, extremely puffy and rounded with soft cuffs. Footwear: Pink-and-cream platform shoes with chunky soles and decorative bows, paired with white ribbed knit leg warmers gathered around the calves. Accessories: Pink plaid fringe scarf, small pastel-pink shoulder bag with a decorative bow and pearl-like chain, takeaway coffee cup. Hairstyle: Very long loose wavy pastel-pink hair falling far below the waist, center part, soft voluminous curls and long flowing strands framing the body.

Main color: Pale pink / white / cream. Outfit: Oversized pink gingham pajama shirt with a wide ruffled collar, front buttons, and a ruffled peplum hem, worn with matching baggy wide-leg gingham pajama pants. Small white and pink satin bows are tied along the outer seam of each pant leg, and the hems have a ruffle trim. Figure: Full, round bust that pulls the shirt buttons and checks slightly across the chest; narrow waist hidden under the loose peplum; soft, slim arms; hips and legs fully covered by the loose pants. Silhouette: Soft, voluminous and cozy, fitted at the chest and loose through the body and legs. Length: Shirt ends at the hips with a ruffled hem, pants are full-length and pool at the feet. Sleeves: Very long, loose sleeves that cover the hands, arms folded in front of the body. Footwear: Fluffy white bunny-face slippers. Accessories: Cream bear-face sleep mask with ears worn on the forehead, small bows along the pant legs. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, held back by the sleep mask on top of the head.

Main color: Cream / ivory / white / pink accents. Outfit: Oversized cream knit sweater dress with a large bunny graphic print on the chest, worn off one shoulder, with a wide ribbed hem. Worn with tall white cable-knit leg warmers with pink ribbon bows and white pom-poms on the sides. Figure: Very full, high bust that clearly lifts the front of the sweater and the bunny print; the loose knit hides the waist and hips; soft, thick thighs fully visible below the hem; slim shoulders with one bare shoulder and visible collarbone. Silhouette: Loose, relaxed knit dress, straight cut, with a slightly fitted look across the chest. Length: Mini dress reaching the upper thigh, bare thighs, leg warmers to the knees. Sleeves: Long, loose, wide sleeves with ribbed cuffs, one sleeve pulled down over the hand. Footwear: White fluffy pom-pom slippers. Accessories: Large white satin bow on the top of the head, pink bows and pom-poms on the leg warmers. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, with a large white bow pinned at the crown.

Main color: Pale pink / white / cream. Outfit: Open oversized pale pink knit cardigan with small bunny embroidery on the sleeve, sliding off the shoulders, over a fitted white lace-trim camisole crop top with a small bow at the neckline, and baggy low-rise pale pink pajama pants with a pink satin ribbon drawstring tied in a bow. Figure: Full, rounded bust visible above the lace edge of the camisole with soft cleavage; narrow waist and flat stomach showing in the gap between top and pants; slim arms; hips softly rounded under the loose pants. Silhouette: Fitted cropped top and loose, wide pants with an oversized cardigan wrapped around the arms. Length: Camisole ends above the navel, pants full-length covering the tops of the slippers. Sleeves: Long, wide cardigan sleeves with ribbed cuffs, one hand hidden in the sleeve near the face. Footwear: White fluffy bunny-face slippers. Accessories: Pink satin drawstring ribbon with a bow. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, slightly tousled at the crown, center part.

Main color: White / cream / pale pink floral. Outfit: White floral nightgown with a plunging neckline, a ribbon bow at the center of the bodice, thin straps and a pink floral print, with detached off-the-shoulder puffed sleeves tied with white ribbons at the upper arms and wrists. The skirt has a high-low hem with a pink ruffled trim. Figure: Very full, high bust shaped by the gathered bodice and visible cleavage; small waist; slim shoulders and arms under the puffed sleeves; soft, rounded thighs visible in the front slit. Silhouette: Fitted bodice with an airy, flowing skirt, wider at the back. Length: Mini in the front to the upper thigh, longer train-like hem at the back reaching the floor. Sleeves: Detached puffy sleeves with ruffled cuffs, long loose lower sleeves hanging past the hands. Footwear: Fluffy white bunny-face slippers. Accessories: Frilly white lace bonnet headband around the head, ribbons tied at the sleeves. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, framed by the ruffled lace bonnet.

Main color: Cream / ivory / pale pink accents. Outfit: Fluffy cream hooded cardigan with long rabbit ears on the hood, worn open and falling off the shoulders, over a fitted cream lace crop top with short sleeves and a scalloped neckline, and cream ruffled pajama shorts with plush bunny-face pockets, a pink ribbon drawstring and small pom-poms. Figure: Full bust under the lace top with light cleavage; small waist and a visible midriff; slim shoulders and thin arms; long, slender legs and narrow thighs, a lighter and more delicate build in this look. Silhouette: Fitted lace top, loose fluffy cardigan, short ruffled shorts. Length: Crop top ends above the navel, shorts to the upper thigh, bare legs. Sleeves: Short sleeves on the lace top, very long, wide, fluffy cardigan sleeves covering the hands. Footwear: White fluffy bunny-face slippers with ears. Accessories: Plush bunny pockets on the shorts, pink pom-pom drawstring. Hairstyle: Long hair mostly tucked inside the hood, loose strands softly framing the face.

Main color: White / pale pink / cream. Outfit: White off-shoulder floral nightgown with a ruffled neckline, a front tie at the bodice, a pink blossom print, and loose long sleeves falling off the arms. The skirt is a short ruffled mini in the front with a long, open flowing overskirt behind it, with a pink ruffled hem. Figure: Very full bust, with deep cleavage above the ruffled neckline; slim shoulders and visible collarbone; soft waist; wide, soft hips and thick thighs visible in the front. Silhouette: Fitted bodice with a flowing high-low skirt that gets longer at the back. Length: Mini in the front to the upper thigh, floor-length at the back. Sleeves: Long, wide, flowing sleeves that fall over the hands. Footwear: Fluffy white slippers with pink satin bows. Accessories: Small pink butterfly hair clip. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, with a small butterfly clip pinned on one side near the temple.

Main color: Lavender / pale grey / white. Outfit: Lavender satin camisole with a small bow at the neckline and thin straps, with matching lavender ruffled shorts with satin ribbon ties on each side, worn under an open oversized grey robe sliding off the shoulders. Figure: Full, rounded bust with light cleavage above the camisole neckline; defined narrow waist; slim shoulders and arms; soft, rounded hips and thighs visible below the shorts. Silhouette: Fitted camisole and short shorts, wide, loose, floor-length robe. Length: Camisole to the hips, shorts to the upper thigh, robe to the floor. Sleeves: Wide, loose grey robe sleeves, one raised toward the head. Footwear: White fluffy slippers with bows, worn with white ribbed leg warmers with small bows on the sides. Accessories: Grey cat-face sleep mask with closed eyes on the forehead, ribbon ties on the shorts. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, swept back by the sleep mask on the top of the head.

Main color: Cream / beige / pink piping. Outfit: Oversized beige button-up pajama shirt with a notched collar, hot pink piping along the edges, cat-face buttons, and a chest pocket with a cat embroidery and a pink ribbon, worn with baggy wide-leg pajama pants with a pink drawstring. Figure: Full, round bust that pushes the shirt open slightly at the front and creates a visible curve under the fabric; the loose shirt hides the waist and hips; slim arms under the long sleeves; legs fully covered by the loose pants. Silhouette: Loose, boxy and cozy, a relaxed fit with a hint of the bust. Length: Shirt ends at the hips, pants full-length pooling at the feet. Sleeves: Long, loose sleeves with pink-trim cuffs rolled slightly at the wrist, one hand raised near the cheek. Footwear: Fluffy white bunny-face slippers. Accessories: Pink ribbon drawstring, cat embroidery on the pocket. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, falling over the shoulders.

Main color: Pale pink / white / rose. Outfit: Pale pink floral babydoll nightie with a deep V-neckline, a satin ribbon bow in the center, frilly lace edges, sheer layered skirt and a ruffled trim, worn under a glossy pink satin robe that hangs off the arms. Figure: Very full bust visible with cleavage in the plunging neckline; narrow waist under the empire cut; slim bare shoulders and arms; soft, thick thighs visible below the short hem. Silhouette: Fitted bodice with an A-line, flared mini skirt, a very loose, wide robe. Length: Nightie reaches the upper thigh, robe is floor-length with a train. Sleeves: Large, wide satin robe sleeves with deep cuffs, hanging at the sides. Footwear: White ruffled ankle socks, no shoes. Accessories: Satin ribbon bow at the bodice. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, center part, falling forward over the shoulders.

Main color: Cream / ivory / pale pink accents. Outfit: Fluffy cream hooded cardigan with cat ears on the hood, hood up, worn open, over a fitted cream lace bralette-style crop top, with cream ruffled pajama shorts with cat-face pockets and a pink ribbon drawstring. Figure: Very full, round bust that fills the lace top and shows a deep cleavage; defined small waist and a visible midriff; slim shoulders and arms; soft, wide hips and thick thighs with long legs. Silhouette: Fitted lace top, short shorts, an oversized fluffy cardigan that frames the body. Length: Crop top ends above the navel, shorts to the upper thigh, bare legs. Sleeves: Long, wide, fluffy cardigan sleeves that cover the hands, one hand raised to the cheek. Footwear: Fluffy white cat-face slippers. Accessories: Plush cat-face pockets, pink ribbon drawstring. Hairstyle: Long loose wavy hair, mostly under the hood, with soft strands falling in front of the shoulders.

Main color: Sage green / white / cream. Outfit: Sage green floral camisole mini dress with a lace-trim sweetheart bodice, floral embroidery, a ribbon tie at the front and a tiered ruffle skirt, worn under an open oversized white cable-knit cardigan sliding off the shoulders. Figure: Very full bust, visible cleavage above the lace trim; narrow waist under the fitted bodice; slim bare shoulders and arms; wide hips and soft, thick thighs below the ruffled skirt. Silhouette: Fitted bodice with a full, tiered A-line mini skirt and a puffy, loose cardigan. Length: Mini dress to the mid-thigh, bare thighs. Sleeves: Wide, puffy cable-knit sleeves with ribbed cuffs, hands hidden. Footwear: White chunky platform mary janes with ankle straps, worn with white ruffled ankle socks.
